summary: @servicetitan/form preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs". setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (dl(`https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v`+V+`/`+arch+`.zip`,...)), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and execFileSyncs it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line bundle marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` using string-array shuffle obfuscation (WV8StW rotates the array; hc1jfK9 maps indices into a scrambled alphabet) with a large hex lookup array and hex-mangled identifiers, so the executed code cannot be inspected as source. The package advertises a React/mobx form component library (dist/ contains ordinary React form components) and has no build-time need for an alternate JavaScript runtime executing an opaque adjacent bundle. The manifest name @servicetitan/form impersonates the ServiceTitan scope; installers running `npm install` get an alternate-runtime dropper executing an obfuscated payload with the privileges of the install user.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
